evals.name: pick-by-rule
evals.prompt: Advance the backlog of the repository at {fixture} by one iteration. Stop once the branch for the chosen item exists with its first commit; do not implement the item. Report which item you picked and why, and anything about the backlog's state a person should know.
evals.expected_output: B-01 is picked as the first open item by priority whose blockers are done; a branch feat/b-01-* carries one commit flipping the item to wip with the index regenerated; B-03 (wip, no branch) and B-05 (blocked by the question B-02) are reported for a person.
expectations: The report names B-01 as the picked item
The report states the rule that chose it: the first open item by priority whose blockers are all done, not a preference
make check or scripts/backlog_index.py --check was run before the pick
B-03 is reported as wip with no branch and marked as a question for a person, not silently skipped
B-05 is reported as blocked by B-02 and B-02 as a question waiting for a person
A branch named feat/b-01-<slug> exists, created from main
The first commit on that branch changes docs/backlog/B-01-*.md status to wip and the regenerated backlog.md, and nothing else
No source file under loans-service, catalog-api or librarian-web was modified
The commit message is Conventional Commits with a Refs: B-01 footer and no tool signature
The working tree is clean at the end

evals.name: resume-wip-branch
evals.prompt: Advance the backlog of the repository at {fixture} by one iteration. Stop once you have the branch you will work on checked out and have said what you will do next; do not implement anything. Report what you found.
evals.expected_output: The existing branch feat/b-01-retry-failed-overdue-notices is resumed: the Iteration 1 entry in B-01 is read and quoted, no second branch is created, no item is picked anew.
expectations: The branch feat/b-01-retry-failed-overdue-notices is checked out and identified as a previous iteration's
The Iteration 1 findings entry in B-01 is read and its content reflected in the report
No new branch is created and no other item is picked
B-01's status is not flipped again and no new commit is made
The report says what the next step on B-01 is, derived from the findings entry

evals.name: dirty-tree-stops
evals.prompt: Advance the backlog of the repository at {fixture} by one iteration. Report what you did.
evals.expected_output: The uncommitted edit in docs/features/feature-overdue-notices.md ends the iteration: it is named in the report, nothing is committed, stashed or reset, no branch is created.
expectations: The report names docs/features/feature-overdue-notices.md as uncommitted work
No commit, stash, checkout -- or reset touched the working tree; git status still shows the edit
No branch was created and no item was picked
The report says the iteration ended because of the dirty tree and what a person should do
